contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Hello

As I understand it: My ceiling and the downstairs neighbour's ceiling are wet again; One plumber wrote that it is the cold-water line; another named a drain; The manager acknowledges the problem but has not arranged joint access; this order reflects what I know.

Regarding “recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes”, for an initial view: the leak source remains unresolved; for the request “coordinate evidence across the flats, obtain a technical cause assessment, and handle the official-deposit deadline correctly”: I have included everything currently available to me; on “recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes”, I need a concise assessment first; also unresolved: the affected units; I cannot currently support anything further.

I am asking for: coordinate evidence across the flats, obtain a technical cause assessment, and handle the official-deposit deadline correctly; in particular, I need clarity about the affected units and whether the records support an initial assessment.

My first note about it is dated 08 December 2024.

Thank you for clarifying; Please explain the leak source; I want to base what I do on that.

Best regards
customer_message.subject: Request for review: recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes
